contracts.expected_type: ∀ saved current : BitVec 64, JabberwockFormal.EmittedGate.executeGateBranch saved current = JabberwockFormal.EmittedGate.GateBranch.continue ↔ current = saved ∧ current ≠ (18446744073709551615 : BitVec 64)

∀ (facts : JabberwockFormal.CheckElision.AnalyzerFacts) (root : Option JabberwockFormal.CheckElision.AnalyzerFact) (i : Nat) (a : JabberwockFormal.CheckElision.Access), JabberwockFormal.ElisionDecision.FactSoundAtAccess facts root a → JabberwockFormal.ElisionDecision.elideFirst facts root i = true → JabberwockFormal.CheckElision.checkedRead a.saved a.current a.payload = JabberwockFormal.CheckElision.uncheckedRead a.saved a.current a.payload
∀ (writable : Bool) (saved current : BitVec 64), JabberwockFormal.Jwc.ReferenceAccess.checkedWrite writable saved current = Except.ok () → writable = true

∀ {s result : JabberwockFormal.Ownership.Store} {source target : Nat}, JabberwockFormal.Ownership.Unique s → JabberwockFormal.Jwc.ReferenceAccess.moveOwner s source target = Except.ok result → JabberwockFormal.Ownership.Unique result
∀ (writable : Bool) (saved current : BitVec 64), JabberwockFormal.Rust.ReferenceAccess.checkedWrite writable saved current = Except.ok () → writable = true

∀ {s result : JabberwockFormal.Ownership.Store} {source target : Nat}, JabberwockFormal.Ownership.Unique s → JabberwockFormal.Rust.ReferenceAccess.moveOwner s source target = Except.ok result → JabberwockFormal.Ownership.Unique result
